snippet.title: The antenna finally worked
snippet.description:
Five summits in Austria. Two failed, three worked, and on every one of them I couldn't tell you why. The answer was waiting at home.

Back in Poland I put the end-fed on a borrowed NanoVNA. It was resonant near 13.5 MHz, not on twenty metres. On 20 m, the band I used on every summit, the SWR was 4.

So we took it into the forest and cut it, a little at a time, until it sat where it should. After the trim: SWR 1.17 on 14.300 MHz.

It was the antenna. The whole trip.

That still leaves one thing I can't explain. The same wire at SWR 4 gave me thirteen contacts and a pileup on Kühgundkopf, through a radio with no tuner that should have been cutting its own power. If you've worked people on an end-fed that far off resonance, tell me how much of that is the 49:1, the band, or luck. I'd rather ask than guess.

—

AUSTRIA, THE ANSWER
Measured and trimmed in Poland, after the trip
Before: SWR 4 on 20 m, resonance near 13.5 MHz
After: SWR 1.17 at 14.300 MHz and 1.00 for 7.090 MHz

The five summits:
Große Schlicke OE/TI-441 · Aggenstein OE/TI-468 · Sulzspitze OE/TI-435 · Kühgundkopf DL/AL-049 · Brentenjoch OE/TI-457

—

ANTENNA
End-fed half-wave, 49:1 transformer, choke balun
Yaesu FT-857D on every summit
NanoVNA (borrowed)

—

We're a family that carries a radio up mountains. Four kids, one licence between us so far, and now one antenna that is finally the right length.

Instagram: @fota_sota
QRZ: HF2LT

snippet.title: 日本無線のアマチュア無線機はなぜ消えた？｜1万台のNRD-525と136万局から55万局へ
snippet.description:
船の無線とレーダーで知られる日本無線（JRC）。その会社は1977年から30年、アマチュア無線家と短波放送を聞く人のための受信機・無線機を作っていました。
1985年の受信機 NRD-525 は1万台以上を出荷。しかし国内のアマチュア無線局は、1994年度末の136万4千局から2005年度末には55万5千局まで減ります。
日本無線のアマチュア無線機は、なぜ消えたのか。

snippet.title: Sinyal MISTERIUS Perang Dingin: Sejarah Radar Raksasa Duga Uni Soviet 📡❄️
snippet.description:
Dalam sejarah Perang Dingin dan rekayasa teknologi militer abad ke-20, Uni Soviet membangun salah satu fasilitas radar over-the-horizon (OTH) terbesar di dunia yang dikenal sebagai Radar Duga. Mulai dioperasikan pada dekade 1970-an, struktur baja raksasa setinggi 150 meter dan lebar 500 meter ini dirancang sebagai sistem peringatan dini untuk mendeteksi potensi peluncuran rudal balistik antarbenua (*intercontinental ballistic missile*) dari jarak ribuan kilometer.

Secara analisis rekayasa frekuensi radio, Radar Duga memancarkan sinyal pulsa berdaya sangat tinggi pada pita gelombang pendek (HF). Sinyal gelombang mikro ini memantul melalui lapisan ionosfer Bumi untuk mendeteksi target jarak jauh. Akibat kekuatan transmisi dayanya yang masif, pancaran sinyal radar ini menimbulkan gangguan interferensi berupa suara hentakan berulang (*repetitive tapping noise*) pada siaran radio gelombang pendek, navigasi penerbangan, serta komunikasi amatir di seluruh dunia. Fenomena gangguan frekuensi global ini membuat Radar Duga dijuluki oleh operator radio internasional sebagai *"Russian Woodpecker"*.

Kompleks radar Duga-1 berlokasi strategis di dekat fasilitas Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Nuklir Chernobyl untuk memenuhi kebutuhan pasokan energi listriknya yang sangat besar. Namun, sejarah mencatat bahwa insiden bencana nuklir Chernobyl pada tahun 1986 secara mendadak menghentikan operasional radar ini akibat gangguan jaringan daya serta radiasi lingkungan di kawasan *Chernobyl Exclusion Zone*. Fasilitas militer rahasia tersebut akhirnya dinonaktifkan secara permanen pada akhir era Perang Dingin.

Dokumentasi mengenai sejarah instalasi Radar Duga ini memberikan wawasan mendalam mengenai sejarah sains telekomunikasi, dinamika geopolitik Perang Dingin, serta perkembangan teknologi radar modern. Penelusuran materi edukasi ini bertujuan untuk memberikan pembelajaran publik mengenai ilmu fisika gelombang radio, sejarah teknologi militer abad ke-20, serta analisis sejarah geopolitik secara objektif, netral, dan ilmiah.

snippet.title: От нас скрывают, у нас не всё хорошо! Питер после массированного прилета БПЛА. Опрос
snippet.description:
«Там как в печи была температура»: как Петербург пережил ночную атаку беспилотников

В ночь на 18 октября беспилотники атаковали Петербург и Ленинградскую область. В одном из жилых домов на проспекте Космонавтов после взрыва начался пожар, а затем квартиры затопило горячей водой из прорвавшихся труб. Пожилая пара с четвертого этажа получила тяжелые травмы. На Васильевском острове повреждения остались в жилых домах и других зданиях. Корреспондентка SOTAvision побывала на местах ударов и поговорила с очевидцами.

🔸 Проспект Космонавтов: взрыв, пожар и затопление кипятком

Около трех часов ночи беспилотник задел крышу дома, 20к1 на проспекте Космонавтов и взорвался на четвертом этаже. По словам очевидцев, тротиловый заряд упал у подъезда.

На четвертом этаже жила пожилая пара. Мужчина получил ожоги около 70% тела и попал в реанимацию, рассказали корреспондентке SOTAvision жильцы. Его супруга также пострадала: ее состояние очевидцы описали как среднетяжелое. На пятом этаже в момент атаки никого не было — жильцы уехали.

Один из очевидцев рассказал о том, в каких условиях люди выбегали из подъезда после взрыва:

«Мы выходим из подъезда, они успели выбежать, но там как в печи была температура. У него сгорели волосы, кожа кусками свисала».

После взрыва огонь распространился по дому, а затем прорвало трубы. Горячая вода хлынула в квартиры. По словам жильцов, натяжные потолки провисли почти до пола, стены и обои оказались повреждены. Две квартиры выгорели практически полностью.

Полиция начала эвакуацию вскоре после взрыва. Сотрудники стучали в двери квартир и выводили людей из дома. Около семи утра жильцов отвели в школу. Там их осмотрели специалисты, а волонтеры помогали с едой и другими необходимыми вещами.

Вернуться домой людям разрешили примерно через 12 часов после эвакуации — уже после работы саперов. Семьям предложили временное размещение в маневренном жилищном фонде. Сколько денег жильцы смогут получить в качестве компенсации за поврежденное имущество, пока неясно. По словам одного из собеседников SOTAvision, речь шла о возможной выплате в 10 тысяч рублей, но официального подтверждения этой суммы нет.

🔸 Васильевский остров: поврежденная больница, отель и жилой сектор

На Васильевском острове последствия атаки заметны на нескольких зданиях в районе 4-й и 5-й линий. Корреспондентка SOTAvision увидела выбитые и заклеенные пленкой окна в домах № 47, 49, 51 и 53, а также в доме № 62 и здании наркологической больницы по адресу 58–60, литера В.

У расположенного напротив отеля оказалась разбита стеклянная дверь. На одном из зданий была повреждена часть крыши.

К моменту приезда нашей корреспондентки основные экстренные работы, судя по обстановке, уже завершились. Часть окон успели заменить, другие оставались разбитыми или закрытыми пленкой. Жильцы вернулись в квартиры. На месте еще висели отдельные сигнальные ленты, но сотрудников экстренных служб корреспондент не увидела.

snippet.title: Homebrew Radio for POTA and FT 8
snippet.description:
The current drivers in the ham radio hobby are POTA (Parks on the Air) and FT-8. 

You can actually build a modern radio that can achieve both of those goals without spending a fortune or apologize for something that looks like a hunk of junk. At my age I have also found these modes are indeed chick magnets. (More than one "granny" has been turned on by the Juliano Blue front panel!)

The heart of the rig is the IF Module featuring the Plessey Bilateral Amp stage as found in EMRFD. SMD parts are used extensively in this radio

This is not a beginners rig so few will ever be constructed. But what it does demonstrate that it can be done. You will need the N6QW Digital Adapter to do FT-8. 

There is no AGC in the radio and you need to crank back the volume on strong signals. The ILI 9341 display sure adds a modicum of panache to the finished radio

73's
Pete N6QW

snippet.title: Kenya Voted. 3 Days Later, a Licence to Mine a Sacred Forest Was Signed. How?
snippet.description:
March 4, 2013: Kenya voted. Three days later, while the outgoing government was still in office, Special Mining Licence 351 was signed, giving a company the right to mine Mrima Hill in Kwale for 21 years.

But Mrima Hill was a forest reserve, a nature reserve and a national monument, and mining in Kwale District had been banned since 1997. A Kenyan court later ruled the licence void, and a tribunal in Washington agreed it was issued against Kenyan law. So how did it get signed?

As Kenya heads toward the 2027 election, the same hill is up for grabs again.

snippet.title: How Cold Is the Top of the World's 5 Highest Mountains? #facts #travel #everest
snippet.description:
Every kilometre you climb, the air gets about 6.5 °C colder. So how cold is the summit of the world's five highest mountains?
 
Estimated summit temperature in a standard atmosphere (15 °C at sea level, −6.5 °C per km):
5. Makalu, 8,485 m: about −40.2 °C
4. Lhotse, 8,516 m: about −40.4 °C
3. Kangchenjunga, 8,586 m: about −40.8 °C
2. K2, 8,611 m (Pakistan / China): about −41.0 °C
1. Everest, 8,849 m: about −42.5 °C
 
Important: these are calculated estimates for standard air, not measured readings. Real summit temperatures change with the season and weather. For Everest, an average low of about −36 °C in January and −18 °C in July is reported on a public Everest weather chart.
 
Which should we climb next: Nanga Parbat or Kilimanjaro? Tell us below.

snippet.title: This Quebec Park Was Activated On Parks On The Air Before POTA Existed! How's That Possible?
snippet.description:
How could a park have been activated in 1985 when Parks on the Air (POTA) didn't even exist until 2017?

During my recent portable ham radio activation at Parc Nature La Gabelle Regional Park (CA-4961) in Québec, Canada, I discovered something that left me scratching my head.

According to the park's activation history, an activation was recorded all the way back in 1985 — more than three decades before POTA began!

How is that even possible?

Was there an earlier amateur radio program operating in these parks? Were historical contacts added to the database? Or is there another explanation entirely?

That's a mystery I'd love to solve, and I'm hoping someone in the amateur radio community can shed some light on it.

Of course, there was plenty of HF radio action during my own visit! With 240 QSOs in the log, Parc Nature La Gabelle turned out to be another fantastic portable operating location in beautiful Québec.

Join me for another ham radio adventure as we enjoy some portable HF operating, make contacts, and explore this rather unusual piece of amateur radio history.

NOW I HAVE A QUESTION FOR YOU!

Have you ever come across a park with an activation date older than POTA itself? Do you know why a 1985 activation would appear in the records?

I'd love to hear your explanation in the comments below. Perhaps someone watching knows exactly what happened!

Thanks for coming along on another adventure with me. If you enjoy portable ham radio, HF operating, chasing DX, antenna experimentation, and exploring great locations, consider subscribing to Out N' Aboot With VE9CF.

73 and good DX!

Stuart – VE9CF
New Brunswick, Canada

snippet.title: 10 Giant Antennas America Built Before Satellites Took Over
snippet.description:
10 Giant Antennas America Built Before Satellites Took Over

Before satellites transformed global communications, America relied on enormous antennas, towering radio masts, and powerful transmission stations to send signals across vast distances. Some were built to communicate with aircraft and ships, while others carried military messages, broadcast radio programs, or supported early experiments in space communication.

In this video, we explore 10 remarkable antenna systems and transmission structures built in the United States before satellite communications became widespread. From massive longwave transmitters and high-frequency radio stations to early space-tracking installations, these engineering projects reveal how people overcame the challenges of communicating across oceans, continents, and remote regions.

Discover the story behind the powerful radio facilities used by the U.S. Navy, the development of long-distance shortwave communication, and the giant antenna systems that helped scientists study the atmosphere and track objects beyond Earth.

We also examine how the Cold War accelerated investment in communications technology and how the arrival of communications satellites gradually changed the role of many ground-based antenna systems.

But satellites did not make antennas obsolete. Radio towers, radar installations, satellite ground stations, and other large antenna systems continue to play important roles in aviation, broadcasting, scientific research, emergency communications, and national defense.

Join us as we uncover the technology, engineering challenges, and historical significance behind these impressive structures. Learn how America built the foundations of modern wireless communication long before satellites became a familiar part of everyday life.

## Sources and References

**1. NASA — Deep Space Network**

Learn about the enormous antennas used to communicate with spacecraft exploring the solar system and beyond.

https://science.nasa.gov/learn/basics-of-space-flight/chapter12-1/

**2. NASA — History of the Deep Space Network**

Historical information about the development of NASA's deep-space communication facilities and large radio antennas.

https://www.nasa.gov/communicating-with-missions/

**3. National Radio Astronomy Observatory (NRAO)**

snippet.title: Newborn Baby Raat Bhar Nahi Sota? 🤱 | Baby Ko Din-Raat Ka Difference Kaise Samjhayein
snippet.description:
Just delivery ke baad newborn baby ka raat mein baar-baar jagna ya na sona bahut common hai. 👶🌙 Newborn babies ko shuru ke weeks mein day-night cycle samajhne mein time lagta hai.

Is video mein maine bataya hai ki aap newborn baby ko dheere-dheere raat aur din ka difference samajhne mein kaise help kar sakte hain.

🌞 Din mein room ko bright aur normal activity rakhein
🌙 Raat mein lights dim aur environment calm rakhein
🤱 Baby ki feeding aur comfort cues ka dhyan rakhein
😴 Dheere-dheere baby ki sleep routine develop hone lagti hai

Important: Newborn ko zabardasti poori raat sulane ki koshish na karein. Frequent feeding aur waking newborn period mein normal ho sakta hai.

Agar aap newborn care, baby sleep, breastfeeding aur postpartum tips ke baare mein helpful information chahte hain, channel ko Subscribe karein. ❤️
